title: Billing and Coding: Treatment of Varicose Veins of the Lower Extremities

codes.1: The Axial/Truncal Veins refer to the superficial venous system which includes the GSV, AASV, SSV, and tributaries draining into those superficial veins. Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT ® codes in their CPT ® book.
